Cross-Domain Few-Shot Prototypical Network (ResNet18 Embedding Space)

Click anywhere on the 2D metric embedding space below to place a Query Tissue Patch (★). The model computes squared Euclidean distances to each class prototype centroid $c_k$ and assigns probabilities via softmax.

Predicted: Benign Tissue (Class A) 3-Way 5-Shot

Softmax Class Posteriors $p_\phi(y=k \mid x) \propto \exp(-d(f_\phi(x), c_k))$:

Domain: Breast Histopathology & BraTS MRI · Backbone: ResNet18 (PyTorch)
